io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; sampling occurs on posedge.

io.name: start_shifting
io.description: Set to 1 forever once sequence 1101 is detected; cleared only by reset.

functional_summary.overview: Finite-state machine that detects the bit sequence 1101 in a serial input stream. Upon detection, start_shifting is asserted and latched to 1 permanently until an active-high synchronous reset clears it.
rules: On posedge clk with reset=1, start_shifting is set to 0 and the FSM returns to the initial state.
On posedge clk with reset=0, the FSM advances based on data, tracking the longest suffix of the input seen so far that is a prefix of 1101.
States: S0 (no prefix), S1 (seen '1'), S2 (seen '11'), S3 (seen '110'), S4 (detected '1101').
When the FSM enters S4 (sequence 1101 detected), start_shifting is set to 1 and remains 1 for all subsequent cycles until reset.
start_shifting is a registered output updated on posedge clk, so it reflects detection with one cycle of latency.
